title: Aeneas’ answering victory and the twin lions
intro: Agamemnon kills Deïcoön; Aeneas kills the twin sons of Diocles. Watch the succession of dual forms.

notes.text: ἦ, “he spoke” (past of ἠμί). ἀκοντίζω, cast a javelin: 3sg aor. θοῶς, swiftly.
δόρυ, spear: dat sg. πρόμος, frontline fighter / champion: acc sg.
Αἰνείω: epic gen sg of Αἰνείας. Περγασίδης, son of Pergasus: patronymic, acc sg with Δηϊκόωντα.
“Equally with [Priam's] children”; τέκος, child: dat pl, epic -εσσι.
τίω, honour: unaugmented 3pl impf. ἔσκε, iterative past of εἰμί, “was / used to be.”
“Quick / eager to fight”; inf explains θοός. μετὰ πρώτοισι: among the foremost.
Ruler / lord; nom sg, epithet of Agamemnon (gen κρείοντος).
ἔρυμαι, protect / ward off: unaugmented 3sg past mid; subject ἥ = shield, object ἔγχος.
“The bronze went right through”; διαπρό, through and through; εἴσατο, 3sg aor mid of εἶμι, go / pass (see εἴσομαι in lexica).
“In the lower belly”; νείαιρα, lower / lowest; γαστήρ, belly: dat sg.
ζωστήρ, belt / war-belt: gen sg. ἐλαύνω, drive / strike: 3sg aor, epic -σσ-.
δουπέω, fall with a thud: 3sg aor. ἀραβέω, clang: 3sg aor. τεύχεα, armour (neut pl subject with sg verb).
αἱρέω, take / slay: unaugmented 3sg 2aor. υἷε: acc dual of υἱός, “the two sons.”
ναίω, dwell: 3sg impf. ἐϋκτίμενος, well-built; dat fem sg with Φηρῇ.
“Rich in livelihood / possessions”; βίοτος gen sg -οιο. γένος: acc of respect, “by descent.”
“Flows broadly”; εὐρύ adv. acc neut sg; ῥέω, flow: uncontracted 3sg pres.
τίκτω, beget: unaugmented 3sg 2aor mid. “Lord over many men”; πολέεσσι = πολλοῖς, dat pl; ἄναξ acc sg.
τίκτω: 3sg impf, “begot”; genealogical sequence, no need for “was begetting.”
“Twin sons were born”; διδυμάων + παῖς, nom dual; γίγνομαι, unaugmented 3dual 2aor mid.
οἶδα, know: perf act ptc nom dual; present sense, “versed in,” + gen μάχης.
ἡβάω, reach manhood: aor act ptc nom dual.
μέλας + ναῦς, gen fem pl; “on black ships.” εὔπωλος, rich in horses, with Ἴλιον.
ἕπομαι, follow: 3dual aor mid; ἅμα + dat, “along with the Argives.”
Ἀτρεΐδῃς: dat pl, sons of Atreus. ἄρνυμαι, win / gain: pres mid ptc nom dual; “winning honour for…”
αὖθι, there / on that spot. “The end of death,” i.e. death's consummation; τέλος subject of κάλυψεν, τώ object.
“Like two lions”; οἷος and λέων, nom dual. Answered by τοίω at 559, “such were the two.”
τρέφω, rear: 3dual 2aor pass, “were reared.” ὑπὸ μητρί: under their mother / in her care.
τάρφος, thicket / dense growth: dat pl; ὕλη, woodland: gen sg.
ἁρπάζω, seize / carry off: pres ptc nom dual. ἴφιος, strong / fat; μῆλα, sheep / small livestock.
σταθμός, fold / farmstead: acc pl. κεραΐζω, ravage: unaugmented 3dual impf, epic secondary -τον.
“Until they too were killed”; κατακτείνω, unaugmented 3pl aor pass. Plural verb despite the dual pair.
παλάμη, palm / hand: dat pl; “at men's hands.”
δάμνημι / δαμάζω, subdue / kill: 2aor pass ptc nom dual; ὑπὸ χείρεσσιν, under / by the hands.
καταπίπτω, fall down: unaugmented 3dual 2aor; κατ-πεσ- → καππεσ-.
“Like tall firs”; ἐλάτη + ὑψηλός dat fem pl; ἔοικα perf ptc nom pl. Plural participle resumes a dual subject.
τώ + πεσόντε: acc dual, “the two fallen men.” ἐλεέω, pity: 3sg aor. ἀρηΐφιλος, dear to Ares.
